title: New Jersey Small Claims Court (2026): Limit, Fees & Filing
rank_math_title: New Jersey Small Claims Court (2026): $5,000 Limit & Fees
rank_math_description: New Jersey small claims in 2026: $5,000 limit, $35 fee (+$5 per extra defendant), Special Civil Part to $20,000, 45-day appeals and 4.5% interest.
pdf_outline: Which court? Small Claims ($5,000) / Special Civil Part ($20,000) / Law Division

Checklist: demand letter -> county Special Civil Part -> complaint -> $35 (+$5 per extra defendant) -> court serves -> mediation/trial -> 45-day appeal -> information subpoena / wage execution (10%) / bank levy / statewide lien
